title: Confidentiality across legal matters
context: In 2026 Chile's competition authority approved Itaú's acquisition of Klap subject to mitigation measures addressing the transfer of commercially sensitive information between competitors. This lab uses fictional matters to illustrate the general information-barrier problem, not to assess those companies.
